text:
Maya Chen: Quick question — what's the weirdest non-food item in your desk drawer? Pics very welcome :eyes:
Jorge Alvarez: A folded subway map from 2008. no idea why i still have it :joy:
Priya Nair: A tiny soldering iron. used it once to fix a toy and it never left. useful? maybe. weird? definitely.
Samir Patel: Taco-shaped stress ball that's serving as a paperweight. don't @ me, it's satisfying to squeeze. :taco:
Emma Li: Single chopstick. found it when i moved. it's my lucky stick now. photo: https://imgur.com/abcd123
Alex Kim: Spare charger that only fits a Nokia 3310. still charges the nostalgia battery. :phone:
Maya Chen: Also a 2010 concert wristband i can't throw away. sentimental clutter :heart:
Priya Nair: 3 rubber bands + a random coin from Croatia. the coin looks like a tiny frisbee.
Jorge Alvarez: Posting proof: https://imgur.com/xyz987 — old key + fortune cookie slip. yes that's a single fortune that says "You will find a pen."
Samir Patel: Practical oddity: tiny screwdriver set. once saved my headphones mid-commute. legit hero.
Emma Li: Hypothetical emergency: which one would you grab first? i'm taking the wristband lol
Alex Kim: Screwdriver set for me too. or the nokia charger if we're going full retro survival.
Maya Chen: This thread rules. keep the pics coming :laughing:
